commit.message: feat(dcp): plugin package build, never-list lint, defaultEnabled:false

pr.title: feat(dcp): DCP plugin packaging build + never-list lint (DMX-DCP-TOOLING-114)
pr.body:
## Summary
- Creates packaging/dcp-plugin/ source layout: skills/ hooks/ mcp/ directories with source files.
- Skills: dcp-preflight, dcp-status, dcp-red-lines — all reference policy exclusively via contract instance files or `dopemux dcp` CLI calls; no lane lists, tier tables, or path-deny prose in skill text (amendment A11).
- build.py compiles packaging/dcp-plugin/ into the official .claude-plugin/plugin.json + hooks/hooks.json + .mcp.json shape.
- Compiled plugin.json: defaultEnabled=false; no monitors, no channels, no default-agent override, no commands/; side-effectful skills have disable-model-invocation:true; stingy allowed-tools.
- Automated never-list lint (amendment A12/SEC-8): CI schema-check of compiled .claude-plugin/plugin.json fails deterministically on monitors, channels, default-agent override, or commands/ presence.
- Cross-project value: dcp-core profile + dcp-profile-dopemux; profiles add denies, never weaken core.

## Validation
- scratch-project install check (defaultEnabled:false).
- Never-list lint red/green demonstrated.
- Skills contain no policy prose.
- BUILD_AFTER_CORE_CONTRACTS gate OPEN confirmed (C1+C5 at L3).

## NOT_RUN
- dcp-profile-dnh-crm (future cross-project profile).
- V2 monitors-as-telemetry (deferred).

steps.task: Preflight: confirm BUILD_AFTER_CORE_CONTRACTS gate is OPEN (TP-112 merged, C1+C5 at L3 in manifest). Inspect existing .claude/ plugin shape conventions. Read DR-015 §4 mapping as referenced in design D-J.
commands: python -c "import json; m=json.load(open('schemas/dcp/manifest.json')); c1=[c for c in m['contracts'] if c['contract_id']=='dcp_red_lane_taxonomy'][0]; c5=[c for c in m['contracts'] if c['contract_id']=='dcp_resource_map'][0]; print('C1 level:', c1['level']); print('C5 level:', c5['level'])"
validation: BUILD_AFTER_CORE_CONTRACTS gate OPEN recorded in proof.

steps.task: Create packaging/dcp-plugin/ source layout and skill files. Skills must: (1) reference dcp preflight/status/red-lines via CLI invocation only; (2) contain no lane lists, tier tables, or path-deny prose; (3) use disable-model-invocation:true for any side-effectful skill; (4) declare stingy allowed-tools (only the specific Bash calls needed to invoke dopemux dcp subcommands). Write packaging/dcp-plugin/hooks/hooks.json with the PostToolUse/PreToolUse hooks that consume the taxonomy-derived rules via the dcp CLI, not by importing red_lane_rules directly.
validation: grep -r 'hard_block\|FORBIDDEN_PATH\|red_lane_path' packaging/dcp-plugin/skills/ returns nothing — no policy prose in skill files.
All skill files invoke dopemux dcp subcommands exclusively.

steps.task: Implement packaging/dcp-plugin/build.py that compiles the source tree into .claude-plugin/plugin.json per the canonical DR-015 §4 plugin.json shape. Compiled manifest must: defaultEnabled=false; no monitors field; no channels field; no default-agent override; no commands/ entries (skills only); side-effectful skills have disable-model-invocation:true; allowed-tools is explicit and minimal.
validation: python -c "import json; p=json.load(open('.claude-plugin/plugin.json')); assert 'monitors' not in p, 'monitors forbidden'; assert 'channels' not in p, 'channels forbidden'; assert 'commands' not in p, 'commands forbidden'" exits 0.

steps.task: Implement automated never-list lint: a deterministic CI check of the compiled .claude-plugin/plugin.json that fails with a clear error on presence of: monitors field, channels field, default-agent override, or commands/ directory entries. Add this as a CI step in .github/workflows/ci-complete.yml. Demonstrate both red (lint fails when violation injected) and green (clean plugin passes) scenarios.
validation: Never-list lint CI step present in ci-complete.yml.

steps.task: Validate scratch-project install: copy .claude-plugin/ to a temp directory and confirm the plugin does not auto-enable (defaultEnabled:false means the user must explicitly enable). Run the full plugin test suite.
validation: Scratch install confirms defaultEnabled:false — plugin does not activate automatically.

steps.task: Run full plugin build test suite, write PROOF.json with PASS/FAIL/NOT_RUN buckets, confirm diff scope inside allowlist. Record BUILD_AFTER_CORE_CONTRACTS gate status as OPEN.
validation: git diff --name-only HEAD confirms only allowlist files changed.
Auditor identity differs from implementer in PROOF.json.
